ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Solune uses the camera to draw the paths of the sun and moon over the sky. Nothing is recorded.
ios.NSMotionUsageDescription: Solune uses the motion sensors to know where you point your phone in AR mode.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Your location makes sun and moon times accurate to the minute.
